name: Cockpit component experiment
description: Publish a bounded agent-authored component as a canonical tool result.
mainDocument: Use cockpit_component_publish only when the human asks for a component. First inspect canonical source Item IDs with ZenX self-control. Supply 1-12 earlier Item IDs from the current Thread, a title and <=24 KiB HTML. Do not invent citations. The human opens the result in the experimental Cockpit. HTML runs inside the existing isolated UI frame; no network, command or navigation is available. Use zenx-plugin-ui:init to access event.detail.sdk.handles.read(sourceItemId), then render source text safely with textContent. The component is an interpretation, never authoritative task state.

tools.name: cockpit_component_publish
tools.description: Publish an isolated HTML component with canonical same-thread source Item IDs. Only when explicitly requested. Does not run HTML or change tasks.
